# The pause outlives the removal. A press while paused maps nothing but
# still confirms the slot.
@0 slot 0 gen=1 <- id 1 "Pad A" key=030000000a0000000a00000000000000 home=030000000a0000000a00000000000000 provisional
@100 slot 0 gen=1 <- id 1 "Pad A" key=030000000a0000000a00000000000000 home=030000000a0000000a00000000000000 confirmed
@2300 paused
@2500 slot 0 gen=1 free
@3000 slot 0 gen=1 <- id 2 "Pad A" key=030000000a0000000a00000000000000 home=030000000a0000000a00000000000000 provisional reconnected
@3100 slot 0 gen=1 <- id 2 "Pad A" key=030000000a0000000a00000000000000 home=030000000a0000000a00000000000000 confirmed
@5600 resumed
